routes.change: Cued untrained base at T 1.0 / top-p 1.0 with min-p 0.05 truncation, 4 samples per problem, plurality vote over the finished answers (cap hits cast no vote).
routes.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model base --prompt cue --set hard328 --shard 0/8 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --min-p 0.05 --samples 4 --seed 3000000 --commit COMMIT_SHA && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model base --prompt cue --set math500 --shard 0/5 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --min-p 0.05 --samples 4 --seed 41000000 --commit COMMIT_SHA
routes.rl_command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model rl --prompt plain --set hard328 --shard 0/8 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --min-p 0.05 --samples 4 --seed 3000000 --commit COMMIT_SHA
routes.gap_parts: Wins back part of the reliability part (base right in other samples: 0.43-0.63 of the gap in result-f39ba8, about 13-18 of the 29-answer hard328 vote gap 221 vs 192) and a little of the answer-statement and budget parts (0.03 and 0.25-0.27: tail-token drift, garbled final lines and cap hits; about 1-3 of 328). It cannot reach the capability part (0.27 on hard328, about 8 of 328; 26 of the 36 problems RL's vote wins have no right base sample). Expected net gain over the stored vote over 4: about +4 of 328, or +0.5 to +1 on the 41-problem shard.
routes.why: s4-b says the reward's gain is sharpening the base onto its own most likely complete answer, capped by what the base can already write (pass@k); min-p removes low-probability tail tokens inside each sample, and the vote picks the base's modal complete answer across samples, both without reward and without the loops that a lower temperature causes.
